intro: Designed for the way you live, the Pangram adapts to your space with versatile configurations, soft fabric, and elegant wooden details—bringing comfort and style together effortlessly.

features.title: Bold colors, soft textures, endless charm
features.text: Crafted with durable two-tone fabric, this sofa feels soft to the touch while standing up to elegance, making it a practical choice for modern interiors.

features.title: Smart corners, clutter-free living
features.text: Designed for seamless access, it keeps essentials organized and hidden, transforming unused spaces into functional, clutter-free zones.

features.title: Soft foam for plush comfort
features.text: Equipped with soft foam cushioning, this sofa provides excellent support for long hours of lounging, reading, or simply relaxing.

features.title: Wooden finish armrest with side storage
features.text: The broad armrests provide a comfortable resting space, while its side storage gives you ample space letting you sit back and unwind easily.

features.title: Cosy moves with you
features.text: Loose cushions adapt to your comfort needs, letting you create a cozy, personalized space every time you sit.

name: Pangram 5-Seater Fabric L Shape Sofa With Storage
